name: showcase-studio-site
description: The Showcase Studio marketing site: a TanStack Start app, prerendered to static files and served by a Cloudflare Worker.

scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/static-404.mjs && node scripts/videos-feed.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env goo --profile goo && wrangler deploy --env downloads
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && wrangler versions upload --env goo --profile goo
